title: Did the Atari 2600 Really Invent the First Game Glitch?

scenes.text: 1977 Atari 2600 cartridges hid a secret bug that crashed games worldwide
Many gamers believe the first ever video‑game glitch was a modern console graphics error.
scenes.label: First glitch was modern
scenes.query2: common belief video game glitch history

scenes.text: The real first documented bug was a 1952 relay error in the Harvard Mark II computer, not a 1970s console.
scenes.label: First bug: Harvard Mark II
scenes.query2: first computer bug Harvard Mark II

scenes.label: Myth vs Fact
scenes.sub: Early computers had real bugs before games.
